paper_title: Covering a Polyomino-Shaped Stain with Non-Overlapping Identical Stickers
classifications: Theory of computation → Problems, reductions and completeness
statement: We have shown that Troublesome Sticker is decidable for polyominoes, but what if the domain is not polyominoes? The following problem is, to the best of our knowledge, unsolved even for d = 1.
context: 6 Open Problems We have shown that Troublesome Sticker is decidable for polyominoes, but what if the domain is not polyominoes? The following problem is, to the best of our knowledge, unsolved even for d = 1. ▶ Question 1. Let d be a positive integer and P be the set of all finite subsets of Zd . Define ∼T on P so that for A, B ∈ P, A ∼T B ⇐⇒ ∃x ∈ Zd , A = B + x. Is Troublesome Sticker(P, ∼T , P) decidable? As we have proven, Flat Cover is NP-complete for general polyominoes. What would happen if we limited the height of the stain?
